transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Good to meet you too. I came in because... well, I just can’t shut my brain off anymore. 

It usually starts with one small concern, like a client not responding to a message. But then, within minutes, I’m completely convinced I’m going to lose the contract. And from there my mind just spirals—I start thinking I'll fall behind on my divorce payments, and that I'll never get back to a real leadership role. It just keeps going like that, and I can't seem to stop it.
Do you find yourself worrying like this about many different parts of your life, not just work?

Yeah, it's... it's definitely not just work. It's really everything. My mind just keeps jumping around. 

I'll go from stressing out about my contract work to panicking over the mortgage payments. And then... well, then I'll start worrying about my reputation, like whether people in the Bethesda tech circles think I’m damaged goods now. It's exhausting. Even something small, like a delayed email from a recruiter... it can honestly feel like proof that my whole career is closing down. So, yeah, it hits pretty much every part of my life right now.
Have you been having sudden episodes of intense fear or panic that peak within a few minutes?

No, I wouldn't say I have panic attacks or anything like that. It's not a sudden spike of fear that hits me out of nowhere. It's more of a constant, low-level dread that just runs in the background all the time. It builds up and spirals, like I said, but it's not like a sudden, intense episode that peaks in a few minutes. It's just... always there.
Did these worries begin after a specific stressful event in your life?

Yeah, I guess there was a starting point. It really kicked off when I was fired from my job... that was about thirteen months ago. I figured the stress would pass once I got some income flowing again, but... it never really let up, even after I landed this contract work. It just kind of settled in and stayed.
Have you been feeling down or depressed much of the time?

No, not really. I mean, I'm definitely stressed and worn out from all the worrying, but I wouldn't say I feel depressed or down. It's not like a sadness... it's just this constant tension and fear about everything that could go wrong. So, no, I don't think I'm depressed.
Have these worries been happening more days than not for at least six months?

Yeah, definitely. Like I mentioned, it started about thirteen months ago, and... well, it's been pretty much every single day since then. So, yes, definitely more days than not. Honestly, it's a rare day when I'm not worrying about something.
